authority: RESEARCH FOUNDATION ONLY. Versioned research cost models that economic candidate targets MUST name by id. No cost model here is production-authoritative; expected-utility labels must reference a versioned id (never an unversioned threshold).

cost_kinds.observed: realized historical execution costs (require a live execution ledger; NOT available in the governed research DB today)
cost_kinds.scenario: fixed what-if cost assumption for stress/comparison
cost_kinds.stress: adverse cost assumption for downside bounds

COST_V1_UNDERLYING_SPY.scope: SPY underlying research pilot; NOT validated for QQQ/IWM/options; NOT production

EXEC_EV_SCAFFOLD_V1.behavior: fail-closed if model absent; training/eval-time only; runtime unchanged
EXEC_EV_SCAFFOLD_V1.scope: EV bound adjustment scaffold; NOT a populated cost model

stage1_gaps: no observed-cost ledger in the governed DB (all economic labels are estimated/scenario only)
no per-ticker cost model beyond the SPY pilot
no time-of-day or liquidity-conditioned cost surface
rule_for_economic_targets: any target in the target registry whose family/id is economic (cost_adjusted / cost_threshold / utility / prob_exceed_costs) MUST set cost_model_version to a non-NONE key defined here; enforced by research/stage1_target_foundation/target_registry.py::validate_registry
